commands.name: pokemon info
commands.summary:
Get information about a Pokémon.
No argument shows your selected Pokémon, `new` your newest, a number that Pokémon in your collection. A name shows the species, and `shiny`, `radiant` or `shadow` in the name shows that variant. ◀️ ▶️ page through your collection and ℹ️ shows forms and the evolution line.

commands.name: pokemon list
commands.summary:
Shows a detailed list of all your obtained Pokémon.
Options, in any order:
`sort:<iv|level|name|recent|type|favorite|party|champion>`
`filter:<all|shiny|radiant|shadow|legendary|favorite|champion|party|market>`
`gender:<all|male|female|genderless>`
`view:<detailed|normal|compact>`
`page:<number>` or a bare number
`search:<text>` or any other words
For example `;p shiny compact 2`.
